claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO unit with the model text “C754e” visible; the form factor matches a color MFP (ADF + control panel).

risks.risk: Whether it is fully functional (prints/copies/scans) vs. having faults (common with used MFPs: fuser, transfer belt, drum/toner issues, paper path jams).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on to ready state plus 1 printed page (color test page) and 1 scan to email/USB showing output.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully working / unknown condition until a live print test is shown.

risks.risk: Toner/drum/consumables life remaining (could be near end-of-life, making total cost high).
risks.proof: Photo of the consumables status screen (toner % / drum life) or a screenshot from the control panel showing remaining levels.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as needing replacement consumables soon.

risks.risk: Paper handling configuration (which trays are included, whether any tray/cassette is missing or faulty).
risks.proof: Photos showing all paper trays/cassettes installed and a quick test feeding from each tray (or at least tray 1 and tray 2) during the live print video.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming minimum configuration and possible tray issues.

risks.risk: Network/scan capability (Ethernet/Wi‑Fi settings, scan-to-email/scan-to-folder not configured or not working).
risks.proof: A screenshot/video showing successful scan destination setup and a completed scan result.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as print-only / scan capability unverified.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (e.g., bypass tray, finisher, original document feeder components, cables).
risks.proof: A checklist photo of included items (power cable, network cable, any accessories/finisher/ADF parts) laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as missing unknown accessories.

proof_requests: Print a color test page (showing all colors) and capture the output.
Show consumables status (toner % / drum life) on the control panel.
Demonstrate scanning (scan to USB or email) with a visible successful result.
Photos of all included trays/accessories and a quick paper feed test from each available tray.
response.reason: The model appears readable as Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e from the photo, but there is no proof of working condition, consumables status, or scan/network functionality. For Lagos pickup and pricing, a live print/scan test and consumables screen are required.
